name: Henry Finn
headline: Founder at the intersection of story and technology | Unicorn Studios, Animori, Metacomica, 0N1 Force
about: Henry grew up wanting to be a comic book artist and never really stopped telling stories. He studied cinema at SFSU, taught film at the Academy of Art College, and then spent years running Luminous US Productions, a big commercial production agency. He worked on the Spotify x BLACKPINK shoot, and a Salesforce film he made on a roughly $300K budget has driven $20M+ for Salesforce and is still live today. Now he builds where story meets tech: Unicorn Studios makes films for tech companies, Animori and Metacomica build anime and comics IP with AI, and 0N1 Force is an anime franchise he leads as CEO. He also produces and hosts Silicon Valley Insider and co-founded Executive Intelligence. He is a quiet builder who would rather show the work than pitch himself, and he is here to find people to build Animori with.
